ops.text: Global ~/.gitattributes routes '* merge=mergiraf' (core.attributesfile), and mergiraf's structural Python merge re-indented the CONTENT of triple-quoted template strings in great_docs/core.py (+4 spaces on ~190 lines across two deterministic reproductions) — silently corrupting files the merged code would emit (.gitignore templates, YAML frontmatter). The commits themselves were clean; only the merge result was corrupted. Workaround that fixed it: git -c core.attributesfile=/dev/null merge ... . Affects ANY merge in ANY repo on this machine touching multi-line string literals.
